errors.evidence: The description omits the first category on the x-axis, which is "FinFE".
The y-axis does not have a label. The label "Score" is hallucinated.
The y-axis does not have any units specified. The unit "百分比" (percentage) is hallucinated.
The major tick interval on the y-axis is 20. Describing it as "a multiple of 10" is imprecise and less informative.

The legend and the bars for K-Center-Greedy are green, not blue.
The description incorrectly identifies "FinNA", an x-axis category, as a data series. This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the chart structure.
